c1_recorded_mechanism_under_review.recorded_economic_mechanism_verbatim: The REVISION between successive ALFRED vintages of one macro observation - not its level, not its surprise - is information about data quality and measurement uncertainty, and is genuinely non-price.

killer_row_1.cited_from: canonical gate probes P1 and P10, field family_keys
killer_row_1.economic_mechanism_it_actually_tested: CROSS-SECTIONAL EQUITY SORTING ON EXPOSURE TO A MACRO LEVEL. The identity says so: economic_family MACRO_BETA_XS_STAGE15 - a beta, estimated cross-sectionally (XS) against a macro series, in US_EQUITY. The traded object is a long-short equity book ranked on estimated macro sensitivity. The macro series enters only as the regressor whose beta is estimated.
killer_row_1.why: Three of the four identity components differ and the economic content differs. This row estimates the SENSITIVITY OF STOCKS to a macro level, cross-sectionally, in a different asset class, with a different traded object. A revision is a property of the macro OBSERVATION ITSELF (how much the statistical agency changed its own estimate), carries no cross-sectional dimension, and is not recoverable from the level series at all - the current series overwrites it. What the two share is the SOURCE STRING FRED_ALFRED, and C1 does not even carry that string (probe P5).

killer_row_2.cited_from: canonical gate probes P2 and P11, field family_keys
killer_row_2.economic_mechanism_it_actually_tested: TIMING - the identity names it: MACRO_TIMING_LANES. A macro state variable switches cross-asset exposure lanes on and off. The census records this row as one of the three independent sightings of the structural must-not-repeat: NEXT_CAMPAIGN_CENSUS.json:142, '(R43, R63 macro timing lanes, index-level implied-state timing)'.
killer_row_2.is_a_vintage_to_vintage_revision_the_sam: The MEASUREMENT is different; the MECHANISM IS THE SAME. This is the row that decides the campaign.
killer_row_2.why: As an INFORMATION OBJECT a revision is not a level and is orthogonal to it. But this row was not killed by its choice of macro series - it was killed by its SHAPE: a conditioning variable switching exposure to a premium, and the recorded finding is 'the premium is real, the timing signal is zero'. C1 has that same shape. C1's economic_family is REGIME, which by definition does not predict a return but classifies a state in which some other return is expected to differ; its model_family is DIRECTIONAL_SINGLE_INSTRUMENT, which in this estate's recorded usage is the premium-harvesting family (all 8 rows carrying it are premiums - probe P12: announcement-day premium, calendar seasonality, lead-lag, release surprise, pre-FOMC drift, TERM_PREMIUM_CARRY, volatility term carry). Substituting a revision for a level inside that shape changes the conditioning variable and leaves the mechanism intact. R63 died with a level; C1 proposes to die with a revision.

killer_row_3.hypothesis_ids: 32 rows; P3 returned all 32 ids. RATES_FUTURES subset is 6 rows (probe P9).
killer_row_3.recorded_four_part_identity_verbatim: MACHINE_REPRESENTATION:MACRO_OVERLAY|MACRO_OBSERVATION|{COMMODITY_FUTURES,CROSS_ASSET,EQUITY_INDEX_FUTURES,FX_FUTURES,RATES_FUTURES}|{LIGHTGBM,RIDGE} - 10 distinct family_keys over 32 rows, including MACHINE_REPRESENTATION:MACRO_OVERLAY|MACRO_OBSERVATION|RATES_FUTURES|LIGHTGBM and MACHINE_REPRESENTATION:MACRO_OVERLAY|MACRO_OBSERVATION|RATES_FUTURES|RIDGE
killer_row_3.cited_from: canonical gate probes P3, P8 and P9, field family_keys
killer_row_3.economic_mechanism_it_actually_tested: A MACRO OVERLAY ON A MACHINE-LEARNED PRICE MODEL. The identity names the role exactly: MACRO_OVERLAY. A macro observation is added as an extra feature block to a LIGHTGBM or RIDGE return model built on the price panel; the macro variable's job is to modulate a price-driven prediction.
killer_row_3.is_a_vintage_to_vintage_revision_the_sam: PARTLY, AND THE OVERLAP IS REAL IN C1's OWN ASSET CLASS.
killer_row_3.why: On the INFORMATION axis these 32 rows consumed a macro OBSERVATION, which is the level; a revision is a different object. On the MECHANISM axis the role is the same as C1's: a macro variable supplied as a conditioning/modulating input to an exposure that is otherwise price- or premium-driven, which is the overlay role and the timing role under two names. The model_family does differ - LIGHTGBM/RIDGE against C1's DIRECTIONAL_SINGLE_INSTRUMENT - and under the estate's own rule a model_family difference is a different cell, so this is NOT on its own a duplicate identity. But probe P9 is the specific fact R74 never put on the record: C1's own asset class has already been prosecuted 6 times with a macro observation in a conditioning role, every one NO_ALPHA_EVIDENCE.

killer_row_2.ruling: NEW_ORTHOGONAL_INFORMATION is a condition on the INFORMATION, and a revision plausibly meets it. But this row's recorded failure is not about which information was fed in - the census records the finding as 'the premium is real, the timing signal is zero' (line 142). Feeding a new, genuinely orthogonal conditioning variable into the identical timing shape is the precise experiment whose answer the estate has already bought three times. A reopened MACRO_OVERLAY cell fed a revision instead of a level would be the fourth sighting of the structural pattern, not a new mechanism.

RULING_ON_THE_STRUCTURAL_MUST_NOT_REPEAT.rule_verbatim: TIMING a premium with a conditioning variable. Three independent sightings (R43, R63 macro timing lanes, index-level implied-state timing): the premium is real, the timing signal is zero.
derivation_from_the_recorded_identity_on: COMPONENT 1 - THE CONDITIONING VARIABLE. C1's economic_family as recorded is REGIME. A regime variable does not forecast a return; it classifies a state in which some OTHER return is expected to differ. That is the definition of a conditioning variable. Probe P6 confirms REGIME appears in no recorded row: it is a label minted for this cell, and it names the conditioning role explicitly.

COMPONENT 2 - THE PREMIUM. C1's model_family as recorded is DIRECTIONAL_SINGLE_INSTRUMENT. Probe P12 shows every one of the 8 rows in memory carrying that model_family is a PREMIUM and all 8 are FORWARD_FROZEN: ANNOUNCEMENT_DAY_PREMIUM, CALENDAR_SEASONALITY, CROSS_ASSET_LEAD_LAG, MACRO_RELEASE_SURPRISE, PRE_FOMC_DRIFT, TERM_PREMIUM_CARRY, VOLATILITY_TERM_CARRY. In C1's asset class specifically, the premium is measured and named: TERM_PREMIUM_CARRY|MACRO_RATES_LEVELS|RATES_FUTURES|DIRECTIONAL_SINGLE_INSTRUMENT, and the director brief records the unconditional version at +1.47%/yr net, t 3.20 AS A CONTROL, explicitly blocked (BRIEF FACTS.blocked_datasets[0]).

COMPONENT 3 - THE COMPOSITION. REGIME x DIRECTIONAL_SINGLE_INSTRUMENT in RATES_FUTURES is therefore, from the recorded identity alone and before any data is touched, a conditioning variable setting the exposure of a premium-bearing single-instrument position. That is the structural must-not-repeat stated term for term.

COMPONENT 4 - THE PRIOR. The rule's second sighting, 'R63 macro timing lanes', IS HM_CLOSED_MACRO_TIMING_LANES_R63, which is R74's own killer row 2 (probes P2, P11). The estate has already run this shape with a macro conditioning variable and recorded the timing signal as zero.
RULING_ON_THE_STRUCTURAL_MUST_NOT_REPEAT.ruling: C1 is refused by the structural must-not-repeat, regardless of source, regardless of D1's answer, and regardless of the finding that R74's stated source-overlap ground was insufficient. Per the campaign instruction, that ends the axis for this cell.
RULING_ON_THE_STRUCTURAL_MUST_NOT_REPEAT.why_this_is_not_the_director_inventing_a: The rule is recorded in the census with three sightings and a stated finding. Its two operative terms map onto two of C1's four recorded identity components with no interpretation required: REGIME is the conditioning variable, DIRECTIONAL_SINGLE_INSTRUMENT is the premium harvester in every one of its 8 recorded uses. No borderline number is being rounded into a refusal because no number is involved.
RULING_ON_THE_STRUCTURAL_MUST_NOT_REPEAT.what_would_NOT_be_refused_by_this_rule: A revision cell whose signal is the PREDICTED RETURN rather than a state that modulates another return - i.e. not a conditioning variable at all. That is a different cell, it is NOT ruled admissible here, and it is enumerated under UNRULED_AND_NOT_THEREBY_CLEARED below.

what_is_NOT_ruled: The fred_alfred SOURCE is NOT ruled dead. This ruling finds the opposite of a source-level refusal: the canonical gate holds no row on information_family=FRED_ALFRED_VINTAGE_REVISION at all (probe P5, n_matching 0).
The VINTAGE-REVISION information family as such is NOT ruled dead. It is ruled inadmissible in ONE mechanism role.
D1 is NOT pre-judged. Whether the ALFRED vintage dimension is certifiable is a fact about data and this ruling does not touch it.
No other R74 candidate (C2-C12) is re-opened, re-ruled or disturbed. R74's verdict on them stands.
MECHANISM_SCOPING_GUARD.UNRULED_AND_NOT_THEREBY_CLEARED: Any revision cell that is not premium timing - for example a cross-sectional book ranked on revision magnitude across many macro-sensitive instruments, where the revision is the predicted-return signal rather than a state modulating another exposure. Such a cell is NEITHER refused NOR cleared by this ruling. It has not been adjudicated, it would need its own STAGE-1 and STAGE-2 adjudication including a probe against H_b214b94b_c7a6676b8573, and it is not proposable in this campaign. Silence here is silence, not permission.

The proposed mechanism must NOT be premium timing. The revision must be the predicted-return signal, not a state modulating another exposure. If the director cannot state the mechanism without the words 'when revisions are large, hold more of X', it is the refused shape.

A check-mechanism probe against MACRO_RELEASE_SURPRISE|MACRO_RELEASE_SURPRISE|RATES_FUTURES|DIRECTIONAL_SINGLE_INSTRUMENT (H_b214b94b_c7a6676b8573, FORWARD_FROZEN, no reopen condition) must return a non-overlapping answer, and the proposal must not re-prosecute that channel backward.

The NEW_ORTHOGONAL_INFORMATION claim must be stated in the hypothesis text as the census rule requires, and must be an orthogonality claim about the information AND about the mechanism role, not about the information alone.
